chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa, from Ibn Muskan, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
Al-witr is three rak'ahs; separation is made between them, and in all of them Sūrat Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad is recited.

key_terms.جَمِيعًا: all together, in all of them
key_terms.يُفْصَلُ: they are separated from one another

ai.seo_question: How is al-witr performed and what is recited in it according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning al-witr, describing it as three rak'ahs with separation between them. It also states that in all of these rak'ahs, Sūrat Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad is to be recited.
